scope.selection_rule: Inspect each previously selected Canonical Current Row, or the named closest Context Evidence when the slot is null, against the current contract, comparator, Runtime Compliance Proof, Single Compact Feature Field, storage, Canonical Query Interface, and exact-evaluator gates. Never stitch rows or upgrade a historical identity by metadata retrofit.
scope.required_joint_baseline: One complete destination-compliant method identity with an eligible Exact Row Authority on all five Evaluation Contracts, one sidecar-free D512/L512 Single Compact Feature Field, legal cold-start closure, and runtime-compliance-proof-v1 PASS.
scope.bounded_conclusion: No inspected historical RADIO-GS row is eligible under the current five-contract destination. The matrix identifies the exact promotion inputs for a future complete candidate; it does not claim that the Five-Benchmark Claim Outcome is impossible.
